intake_summary: The packet was classified as a provisional process-ontology induction candidate about semantic indexing of RT organizations. It was routed as a proposed induction-queue item and a proposed lexicon-review item, not as a formal induction or theorem-level claim.

candidate_work_items.title: Semantic RT process indexing and canonical organization candidate

warnings: Semantic index is introduced as a candidate organizational identifier, not a numerical quantity or spatial coordinate.
Canonical indexing and retrieval semantics remain open; retrieval is not established as trivial by this intake alone.
orientation_field is already a governed term elsewhere in the repository and is reused here only as supporting vocabulary.
The packet does not create live authority or alter the RT core expression.
Open questions on canonicalization and projection operators remain unresolved.

unrouted_items.reason: Requires a finite alphabet definition before queue binding or canonization.
Requires a deterministic semantic-index assignment rule before formal induction establishment.
Requires explicit projection operators before any arithmetic, probability, topology, geometry, or physics bridge claim.

provenance.preserved_source_excerpt: The framework shifted from a graph-of-objects interpretation toward a recursively resolving process ontology with semantic process indexing.
